I have just installed Deducer and the jgr Console.  However, after loading Deducer in R, and then opening the jgr Console Package Manager option so that I can load Deducer in jgr, Deducer is not listed as a package that can be checked to be loaded.  Apparently,  I'm missing something  during the installation process.  Any suggestions would be appreciated.  I'm running Windows 7. Thanks.
 
Carl von Ende

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: naive question
parts:
If you used the windows installer
(http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.WindowsInstallation),
you should see Deducer in the package manager (near the top). If you
installed JGR separately, you need to download and install deducer
before you can load it. This can be done by going to Packages & Data >
Package Installer and selecting Deducer.

Ian
